lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a distinct grid-like architecture across the visible mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear features running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light-saturated upper boundaries and shadowed lower boundaries.
